005package org.wpilib.drive;
006
007import static org.wpilib.util.ErrorMessages.requireNonNullParam;
008
009import java.util.function.DoubleConsumer;
010import org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorController;
011import org.wpilib.math.util.MathUtil;
012import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryLoggable;
013import org.wpilib.telemetry.TelemetryTable;
014import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
015
016/**
017 * A class for driving differential drive/skid-steer drive platforms such as the Kit of Parts drive
018 * base, "tank drive", or West Coast Drive.
019 *
020 * <p>These drive bases typically have drop-center / skid-steer with two or more wheels per side
021 * (e.g., 6WD or 8WD). This class takes a setter per side. For four and six motor drivetrains, use
022 * CAN motor controller followers or {@link
023 * org.wpilib.hardware.motor.PWMMotorController#addFollower(PWMMotorController)}.
024 *
025 * <p>A differential drive robot has left and right wheels separated by an arbitrary width.
026 *
027 * <p>Drive base diagram:
028 *
029 * <pre>
030 * |_______|
031 * | |   | |
032 *   |   |
033 * |_|___|_|
034 * |       |
035 * </pre>
036 *
037 * <p>Each drive function provides different inverse kinematic relations for a differential drive
038 * robot.
039 *
040 * <p>This library uses the NWU axes convention (North-West-Up as external reference in the world
041 * frame). The positive X axis points ahead, the positive Y axis points to the left, and the
042 * positive Z axis points up. Rotations follow the right-hand rule, so counterclockwise rotation
043 * around the Z axis is positive.
044 *
045 * <p>Inputs smaller then {@value org.wpilib.drive.RobotDriveBase#DEFAULT_DEADBAND} will be set to
046 * 0, and larger values will be scaled so that the full range is still used. This deadband value can
047 * be changed with {@link #setDeadband}.
048 *
049 * <p>{@link org.wpilib.hardware.motor.MotorSafety} is enabled by default. The tankDrive,
050 * arcadeDrive, or curvatureDrive methods should be called periodically to avoid Motor Safety
051 * timeouts.
052 */
053public class DifferentialDrive extends RobotDriveBase implements TelemetryLoggable {
054  private final DoubleConsumer m_leftMotor;
055  private final DoubleConsumer m_rightMotor;
056
057  // Used for telemetry
058  private double m_leftOutput;
059  private double m_rightOutput;
060
061  private boolean m_reported;
062
063  /**
064   * Wheel velocities for a differential drive.
065   *
066   * <p>Uses normalized voltage [-1.0..1.0].
067   */
068  public static class WheelVelocities {
069    /** Left wheel velocity. */
070    public double left;
071
072    /** Right wheel velocity. */
073    public double right;
074
075    /** Constructs a WheelVelocities with zeroes for left and right velocities. */
076    public WheelVelocities() {}
077
078    /**
079     * Constructs a WheelVelocities.
080     *
081     * @param left The left velocity [-1.0..1.0].
082     * @param right The right velocity [-1.0..1.0].
083     */
084    public WheelVelocities(double left, double right) {
085      this.left = left;
086      this.right = right;
087    }
088  }
089
090  /**
091   * Construct a DifferentialDrive.
092   *
093   * <p>To pass multiple motors per side, use CAN motor controller followers or {@link
094   * org.wpilib.hardware.motor.PWMMotorController#addFollower(PWMMotorController)}. If a motor needs
095   * to be inverted, do so before passing it in.
096   *
097   * @param leftMotor Left motor.
098   * @param rightMotor Right motor.
099   */
100  public DifferentialDrive(MotorController leftMotor, MotorController rightMotor) {
101    this(
102        (double output) -> leftMotor.setThrottle(output),
103        (double output) -> rightMotor.setThrottle(output));
104  }
105
106  /**
107   * Construct a DifferentialDrive.
108   *
109   * <p>To pass multiple motors per side, use CAN motor controller followers or {@link
110   * org.wpilib.hardware.motor.PWMMotorController#addFollower(PWMMotorController)}. If a motor needs
111   * to be inverted, do so before passing it in.
112   *
113   * @param leftMotor Left motor setter.
114   * @param rightMotor Right motor setter.
115   */
116  public DifferentialDrive(DoubleConsumer leftMotor, DoubleConsumer rightMotor) {
117    requireNonNullParam(leftMotor, "leftMotor", "DifferentialDrive");
118    requireNonNullParam(rightMotor, "rightMotor", "DifferentialDrive");
119
120    m_leftMotor = leftMotor;
121    m_rightMotor = rightMotor;
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * Arcade drive method for differential drive platform. The calculated values will be squared to
126   * decrease sensitivity at low velocities.
127   *
128   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
129   * @param zRotation The robot's rotation rate around the Z axis [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is
130   *     positive.
131   */
132  public void arcadeDrive(double xVelocity, double zRotation) {
133    arcadeDrive(xVelocity, zRotation, true);
134  }
135
136  /**
137   * Arcade drive method for differential drive platform.
138   *
139   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
140   * @param zRotation The robot's rotation rate around the Z axis [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is
141   *     positive.
142   * @param squareInputs If set, decreases the input sensitivity at low velocities.
143   */
144  public void arcadeDrive(double xVelocity, double zRotation, boolean squareInputs) {
145    if (!m_reported) {
146      UsageReporting.reportUsage("RobotDrive", "DifferentialArcade");
147      m_reported = true;
148    }
149
150    xVelocity = MathUtil.applyDeadband(xVelocity, m_deadband);
151    zRotation = MathUtil.applyDeadband(zRotation, m_deadband);
152
153    var velocities = arcadeDriveIK(xVelocity, zRotation, squareInputs);
154
155    m_leftOutput = velocities.left * m_maxOutput;
156    m_rightOutput = velocities.right * m_maxOutput;
157
158    m_leftMotor.accept(m_leftOutput);
159    m_rightMotor.accept(m_rightOutput);
160
161    feed();
162  }
163
164  /**
165   * Curvature drive method for differential drive platform.
166   *
167   * <p>The rotation argument controls the curvature of the robot's path rather than its rate of
168   * heading change. This makes the robot more controllable at high velocities.
169   *
170   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
171   * @param zRotation The normalized curvature [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is positive.
172   * @param allowTurnInPlace If set, overrides constant-curvature turning for turn-in-place
173   *     maneuvers. zRotation will control turning rate instead of curvature.
174   */
175  public void curvatureDrive(double xVelocity, double zRotation, boolean allowTurnInPlace) {
176    if (!m_reported) {
177      UsageReporting.reportUsage("RobotDrive", "DifferentialCurvature");
178      m_reported = true;
179    }
180
181    xVelocity = MathUtil.applyDeadband(xVelocity, m_deadband);
182    zRotation = MathUtil.applyDeadband(zRotation, m_deadband);
183
184    var velocities = curvatureDriveIK(xVelocity, zRotation, allowTurnInPlace);
185
186    m_leftOutput = velocities.left * m_maxOutput;
187    m_rightOutput = velocities.right * m_maxOutput;
188
189    m_leftMotor.accept(m_leftOutput);
190    m_rightMotor.accept(m_rightOutput);
191
192    feed();
193  }
194
195  /**
196   * Tank drive method for differential drive platform. The calculated values will be squared to
197   * decrease sensitivity at low velocities.
198   *
199   * @param leftVelocity The robot's left side velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is
200   *     positive.
201   * @param rightVelocity The robot's right side velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is
202   *     positive.
203   */
204  public void tankDrive(double leftVelocity, double rightVelocity) {
205    tankDrive(leftVelocity, rightVelocity, true);
206  }
207
208  /**
209   * Tank drive method for differential drive platform.
210   *
211   * @param leftVelocity The robot left side's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is
212   *     positive.
213   * @param rightVelocity The robot right side's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is
214   *     positive.
215   * @param squareInputs If set, decreases the input sensitivity at low velocities.
216   */
217  public void tankDrive(double leftVelocity, double rightVelocity, boolean squareInputs) {
218    if (!m_reported) {
219      UsageReporting.reportUsage("RobotDrive", "DifferentialTank");
220      m_reported = true;
221    }
222
223    leftVelocity = MathUtil.applyDeadband(leftVelocity, m_deadband);
224    rightVelocity = MathUtil.applyDeadband(rightVelocity, m_deadband);
225
226    var velocities = tankDriveIK(leftVelocity, rightVelocity, squareInputs);
227
228    m_leftOutput = velocities.left * m_maxOutput;
229    m_rightOutput = velocities.right * m_maxOutput;
230
231    m_leftMotor.accept(m_leftOutput);
232    m_rightMotor.accept(m_rightOutput);
233
234    feed();
235  }
236
237  /**
238   * Arcade drive inverse kinematics for differential drive platform.
239   *
240   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
241   * @param zRotation The robot's rotation rate around the Z axis [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is
242   *     positive.
243   * @param squareInputs If set, decreases the input sensitivity at low velocities.
244   * @return Wheel velocities [-1.0..1.0].
245   */
246  public static WheelVelocities arcadeDriveIK(
247      double xVelocity, double zRotation, boolean squareInputs) {
248    xVelocity = Math.clamp(xVelocity, -1.0, 1.0);
249    zRotation = Math.clamp(zRotation, -1.0, 1.0);
250
251    // Square the inputs (while preserving the sign) to increase fine control
252    // while permitting full power.
253    if (squareInputs) {
254      xVelocity = MathUtil.copyDirectionPow(xVelocity, 2);
255      zRotation = MathUtil.copyDirectionPow(zRotation, 2);
256    }
257
258    double leftVelocity = xVelocity - zRotation;
259    double rightVelocity = xVelocity + zRotation;
260
261    // Find the maximum possible value of (throttle + turn) along the vector
262    // that the joystick is pointing, then desaturate the wheel velocities
263    double greaterInput = Math.max(Math.abs(xVelocity), Math.abs(zRotation));
264    double lesserInput = Math.min(Math.abs(xVelocity), Math.abs(zRotation));
265    if (greaterInput == 0.0) {
266      return new WheelVelocities(0.0, 0.0);
267    }
268    double saturatedInput = (greaterInput + lesserInput) / greaterInput;
269    leftVelocity /= saturatedInput;
270    rightVelocity /= saturatedInput;
271
272    return new WheelVelocities(leftVelocity, rightVelocity);
273  }
274
275  /**
276   * Curvature drive inverse kinematics for differential drive platform.
277   *
278   * <p>The rotation argument controls the curvature of the robot's path rather than its rate of
279   * heading change. This makes the robot more controllable at high velocities.
280   *
281   * @param xVelocity The robot's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is positive.
282   * @param zRotation The normalized curvature [-1.0..1.0]. Counterclockwise is positive.
283   * @param allowTurnInPlace If set, overrides constant-curvature turning for turn-in-place
284   *     maneuvers. zRotation will control rotation rate around the Z axis instead of curvature.
285   * @return Wheel velocities [-1.0..1.0].
286   */
287  public static WheelVelocities curvatureDriveIK(
288      double xVelocity, double zRotation, boolean allowTurnInPlace) {
289    xVelocity = Math.clamp(xVelocity, -1.0, 1.0);
290    zRotation = Math.clamp(zRotation, -1.0, 1.0);
291
292    double leftVelocity;
293    double rightVelocity;
294
295    if (allowTurnInPlace) {
296      leftVelocity = xVelocity - zRotation;
297      rightVelocity = xVelocity + zRotation;
298    } else {
299      leftVelocity = xVelocity - Math.abs(xVelocity) * zRotation;
300      rightVelocity = xVelocity + Math.abs(xVelocity) * zRotation;
301    }
302
303    // Desaturate wheel velocities
304    double maxMagnitude = Math.max(Math.abs(leftVelocity), Math.abs(rightVelocity));
305    if (maxMagnitude > 1.0) {
306      leftVelocity /= maxMagnitude;
307      rightVelocity /= maxMagnitude;
308    }
309
310    return new WheelVelocities(leftVelocity, rightVelocity);
311  }
312
313  /**
314   * Tank drive inverse kinematics for differential drive platform.
315   *
316   * @param leftVelocity The robot left side's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is
317   *     positive.
318   * @param rightVelocity The robot right side's velocity along the X axis [-1.0..1.0]. Forward is
319   *     positive.
320   * @param squareInputs If set, decreases the input sensitivity at low velocities.
321   * @return Wheel velocities [-1.0..1.0].
322   */
323  public static WheelVelocities tankDriveIK(
324      double leftVelocity, double rightVelocity, boolean squareInputs) {
325    leftVelocity = Math.clamp(leftVelocity, -1.0, 1.0);
326    rightVelocity = Math.clamp(rightVelocity, -1.0, 1.0);
327
328    // Square the inputs (while preserving the sign) to increase fine control
329    // while permitting full power.
330    if (squareInputs) {
331      leftVelocity = MathUtil.copyDirectionPow(leftVelocity, 2);
332      rightVelocity = MathUtil.copyDirectionPow(rightVelocity, 2);
333    }
334
335    return new WheelVelocities(leftVelocity, rightVelocity);
336  }
337
338  @Override
339  public void stopMotor() {
340    m_leftOutput = 0.0;
341    m_rightOutput = 0.0;
342
343    m_leftMotor.accept(0.0);
344    m_rightMotor.accept(0.0);
345
346    feed();
347  }
348
349  @Override
350  public String getDescription() {
351    return "DifferentialDrive";
352  }
353
354  @Override
355  public void logTo(TelemetryTable table) {
356    table.log("Left Motor Velocity", m_leftOutput);
357    table.log("Right Motor Velocity", m_rightOutput);
358  }
359
360  @Override
361  public String getTelemetryType() {
362    return "DifferentialDrive";
363  }
364}
